text:
Rae: Quick sync  we need to lock the May webinar topic and rehearsal plan by EOD. Proposed theme: "Inference playbooks for product teams". Want 2 lightning demos (6-8m), 1 customer vignette (6m), plus 15m panel/Q&A.
Cal: +1. Keep main session 35-40m so people can join from lunch. Suggest one demo focused on cost (caching/kv) and one on latency (runtime knobs).
Imani: I can do the caching demo. Will prepare a 90s pre-recorded clip as backup and a 1-slide cost table.
Tomas: I'll do runtime knobs (quant + kernel choices). Need 30m green-room rehearsal.
Vera: Customer confirmed but asked for a short brief template. I'll send them a 3-bullet template for the vignette.
Rae: Run-of-show draft (microtiming):
- 0:00-2:30 host intro + agenda + housekeeping
- 2:30-9:00 customer vignette (Vera)
- 9:00-17:00 demo 1 (Imani) live + 60s swap buffer
- 17:00-26:00 demo 2 (Tomas) live + 60s swap buffer
- 26:00-32:00 panel takeaways (host + 2 speakers + customer)
- 32:00-40:00 live Q&A + final CTAs
Rae: Optional 25m deep-dive breakout for engineers after the main session.
Cal: Lead routing: reg form with interest checkboxes (product / infra / research). Map tags to nurture paths. Who owns the form?
Imani: I'll build the form. Add hidden utm=may_infer_playbook and a checkbox for consent to receive follow-ups.
Vera: Also add a GDPR checkbox for EU registrants; customer requested that we avoid sharing their raw logs.
Tomas: Demo infra notes: please run smoke test of demo endpoint 20m before show. I'll add a short smoke script to the repo.
Imani: Upload pre-recorded clips to s3://redwood-webinar/may/backup-clips/ by 5/8 EOD. Name files with short hash like demo-imani-9f4b.mp4 so ops can trigger quickly.
ops-bot: S3 bucket write OK. Caption vendor integrated. Live EN captions available; post-event SRT translation supported.
Rae: Rehearsals: green-room run 5/9 10:00 PT, dress 5/10 11:00 PT. Please confirm ASAP.
Imani: 5/9 green-room works.
Tomas: I can do 5/10 dress; fine to skip green-room if needed but prefer both.
Vera: I'll join both rehearsals with customer. Need the speaker briefing template first.
Cal: Slide deck flow: send to /marketing/shared/decks/may_playbook by 5/7 noon. I'll consolidate and do a narrative pass 5/8 afternoon.
Rae: Small ops asks: gating the replay behind lead capture; retention = 180 days; transcripts + captions attached. Also we need an incident playbook line: if both demos fail, host will run a 6-min whiteboard walk and open Q&A.
Tomas: I'll write the mini incident playbook and paste it here. Short version: "If demo Fails -> 60s attempt restart -> 90s decision window -> play pre-recorded clip -> note in chat it's pre-recorded.
Imani: Add a producer console button to deploy clip. Who builds that?
ops-bot: Producer control button exists in staging. Schedule test 5/6 09:30 PT.
Cal: Metrics: registrations, attendance rate, poll response (mid-session poll: Caching / Quantization / Batching), replay clicks, follow-up conversion. Wire to CDP and analytics.
Imani: Poll will be added mid-session. I will also add a CTA slide linking to the playbook + Git repo.
Vera: Speaker bios & 2-line abstracts due 5/5 EOD. I'll paste the customer blurb here once I get permission.
Rae: Good. Please paste bios in this thread. Also I want one transparent slide showing $/1k tokens for the demo paths with assumptions noted.
Tomas: Abstract: "Kernel and quantization knobs for predictable latency in production." Bio: "Tomas  Runtime Lead, focuses on kernel tuning and latency engineering."
Imani: Abstract: "Caching patterns that trim token spend with minimal tail-latency impact. Live demo + fallback plan." Bio: "Imani  Staff Infrastructure Engineer, runtime caching & KV ops."
Rae: Thanks all. Final checklist for owners: slides in folder (5/7), pre-records uploaded (5/8), rehearsals on calendar (5/9-5/10), producer test (5/6). Locking speaker order tomorrow. :rocket:
